title: Probability and Measure
verification_note: Anniversary/fourth edition. Used for measure-theoretic probability spaces, random variables, expectation, conditional expectation, convergence, laws of large numbers, central limit theory and stochastic-process foundations.

title: All of Statistics: A Concise Course in Statistical Inference
verification_note: First edition. Used for probability distributions, descriptive statistics, estimation, likelihood, confidence procedures, hypothesis testing and broad mathematical-statistics distinctions. Computational data/ML pipelines are excluded under R06.

title: Markov Chains
verification_note: Book DOI and 1997 print edition. Used for discrete-time Markov chains, transition matrices, stationary distributions, irreducibility/aperiodicity and convergence conditions.

title: Bayesian Data Analysis
verification_note: Third edition. Used for prior-likelihood-posterior semantics, predictive distributions, credible intervals, Bayes factors/prior sensitivity, Bayesian decision reasoning, hierarchical models and predictive checking.

title: Design and Analysis of Experiments
verification_note: Tenth edition, June 2019. Used for randomization, replication, blocking, controls, factorial design, matched designs, blinding, experimental units and design/power principles.

title: Causality: Models, Reasoning, and Inference
verification_note: Second edition. Used for causal DAG semantics, Markov factorization, d-separation, collider/back-door reasoning, interventions/do-notation and identification. Generic DAG mathematics remains accepted C08 ownership.

title: Causal Inference for Statistics, Social, and Biomedical Sciences: An Introduction
verification_note: First edition. Used for potential outcomes, randomized assignment, design-based causal reasoning, consistency/interference, observational identification assumptions, instrumental variables and local/quasi-experimental causal estimands.
